design.message: bit=1 iff Q[observed cue] > max(other Q); strict tie to zero
design.neuralSchedule: reset once/sequence; first 680 ms round cue-free; cue 150 Hz 0-240 ms; reset counts 50 ms; Q/bit 240 ms; no drive/reward/dopamine 240-680 ms; preserve state through all 680 ms
design.strategy: seeded initial move from existing Opponent; thereafter (previous+offset)%3; offset A=1,B=2; hidden label used only by evaluator
design.decoder: unchanged prior calibration-only bit0->A, bit1->B lookup
design.shuffle: one heldout bit permutation pooled within cue, rng(2026110402)
design.gates: all teachers and cues complete; frozen weights; heldout B bit1>=18/23 each cue; each heldout teacher decoded>=18/23 each cue; balanced mapping>=80% and >=10pp over cue-only and shuffle each cue; both pooled bits>=20%; both strategies each cue
